name: protect-mcp-assistant
description: Set up protect-mcp for a chosen MCP server, try a harmless policy demo, and verify signed receipts against an expected key. Installation alone does not enable enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Set up policies and verify decision receipts
interface.longDescription: Choose one MCP server to configure, try an allowed and denied policy decision with synthetic inputs, and verify a receipt with the expected signing key. Includes reusable skills and a local demo. No automatic hooks, connected services, or account required. Running the local workflows needs Node.js 22 or later and npm; chat-only sessions can prepare commands and explain results.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up protect-mcp for one MCP server.
Show me a harmless policy and signed-receipt demo.
Verify this receipt against the expected public key.
